Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are back in the middle now. Ailsa Lister and Darcey Carter are the two openers for Scotland Women Under-19. Titas Sadhu to start proceedings with ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then, India Women Under-19 have managed to post a decent total on the board and will be confident of defending this. Scotland Women Under-19 will need to put in their best batting performance if they are to get over the line here. Let's see how the chase unfolds.

Gongadi Trisha is up for a quick chat. She says she enjoyed her game today. Adds that the pitch wasn't as easy as the previous one and the ball wasn't coming on well. Mentions that the outfield was sluggish as well and applauds the efforts of Shweta Sehrawat  towards the end.

Scotland Women Under-19 should be proud of their bowling effort as they troubled a really good batting line-up. They got off to a perfect start getting rid of Shafali Verma early and it reflected on their celebration. Their spinners did a good job of keeping the batter quiet especially Richa Ghosh. They did give her a couple of lives, but that did not cost them that much. There was a point when Richa and Gongadi Trisha were going good, but it was their skipper, Katherine Fraser who came in and dismissed both in the same over to turn things around again. She ended up with a couple of wickets while Orla Montgomery and Nayma Shaikh picked up one each. They will be a bit disappointed with how things ended as they could have restricted their opponents to a lot lesser.

India Women Under-19 will be satisfied with their performance with the blade, but know that they could have got more. They suffered a set back at the start of the innings when Shafali Verma walked back quite early. However, the plan for them was to give every batter a chance and that is why Gongadi Trisha opened the innings and took full advantage of that scoring a good fifty. She and Richa Ghosh steadied the ship with a 70-run partnership, but both of them got out in the same over trying to up the ante. It was once again Shweta Sehrawat who stole the show with her quick-fire 31 off just 10 balls and took her side close to the 150-run mark.

A fine end to the innings from India Women Under-19! Shweta Sehrawat turned on the heat at the fag end of the innings and racked up 20 runs in the last over. Scotland Women Under-19 will feel that they gave away a bit too many runs in the end.

FOUR! Finishes off the innings in fine fashion does Shweta Sehrawat. This is around the pads, Sehrawat pulls it away into the backward square leg fence for another boundary and 20 runs come off the final over. India Women Under-19 finish with 149/4!
SIX! Wow! Shweta Sehrawat is showing her class here. Back to over the wicket and tossed up on off stump, Sehrawat gets down on one knee and slogs it a long way over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.

FOUR! Through! This is bowled from around the stumps and angled across the right-hander, Shweta Sehrawat punches it toward extra cover where the fielder completely misses the ball and it runs away into the fence.
FOUR! This is floated up on leg stump, Shweta Sehrawat stays deep in her crease and powerfully slogs it away past square leg for a boundary.
This is around off, Hrishita Basu pushes it out toward cover for one more.
This is on middle and leg, Shweta Sehrawat drives it down to wide long on for a single.
Katherine Fraser to bowl the last over.

Overthrows! This is short and around off, Hrishita Basu looks to pull but gets a top edge toward third man. They pick up a single and the throw is wide of the keeper which allows them to get back for the second.
FOUR! Well struck! This is full and straight, a low full toss. Hrishita Basu gets under it and thumps it over mid on for a boundary.
On a hard length and around off, Hrishita Basu looks for the lap sweep but it doesn't come off.
Back of a length outside off, Shweta Sehrawat hits it hard and toward sweeper cover for only a single.

DROPPED! Yet another chance missed by Scotland Women Under-19 and the skipper, Katherine Fraser is the culprit this time around. Shorter and on the body, Hrishita Basu pulls it aerially toward cow corner. Fraser runs to her left from deep mid-wicket but fumbles the catch. Just the single then.
This is a slower bouncer well outside off, Hrishita Basu looks to shuffle across and pull it fine but is beaten. No wide is called.
Orla Montgomery to bowl the penultimate over.
FOUR! Put away! This is short and over the stumps, Shweta Sehrawat goes really deep in her crease and powerfully pulls it into the backward square leg fence for a boundary.
SIX! All the way! This is tossed up on middle and leg, Shweta Sehrawat gets down on one knee and slogs it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
WIDE! This is fuller and just spinning down the leg side. Wide called.
A bit of hesitation in the middle but no harm is done. On a length around off, Basu pushes it in front of covers and does scamper through for the single in the end.
Short again around middle, Shweta Sehrawat pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
This is shorter and over middle, Hrishita Basu gets inside the line of the ball and scoops it toward short fine leg for a run.

Unlucky! Olivia Bell floats it up right in the blockhole on leg stump. Hrishita Basu looks to dig it out but gets no bat on it and the ball goes past the stumps and the keeper as well for a couple of byes.
Floated up on a length and outside off, Shweta Sehrawat punches it toward cover.
Shweta Sehrawat comes out to the middle now.

OUT! TAKEN! A double-strike from skipper Katherine Fraser and Scotland Women Under-19 are right back in it. Fraser slows it up a touch and pulls the length back as well. Gongadi Trisha looks to skip down the track and heave it away but gets no timing on the ball. The ball goes toward deep mid-wicket where Darcey Carter runs in and takes a solid sliding catch. Trisha departs after a solid knock and India Women Under-19 have lost both set-batters now.
Commentary.Howout: c Darcey Carter b Katherine Fraser

Commentary.Commentary: This is on middle and leg, Hrishita Basu flicks it through square leg for a single.
Hrishita Basu walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Scotland Women Under-19 do hold onto a catch and the dangerous Richa Ghosh departs. Katherine Fraser tosses it up around middle and serves a full toss. Ghosh steps out and looks to heave it over the deep mid-wicket fence but mistimes it toward wide long on. Olivia Bell over there takes a good catch and the bowling team is ecstatic. A sluggish innings from Ghosh comes to an end.
Commentary.Howout: c Olivia Bell b Katherine Fraser

Commentary.Commentary: Up and over! This is shorter and around off, Richa Ghosh rocks back and lofts it over the cover region. The ball plugs a bit and the batters pick up a couple of runs.
Tosses it up outside off, Gongadi Trisha skips down the track and drives it down to long off for a single.
Katherine Fraser is back on.
Nicely bowled! This is the slower bumper from Orla Montgomery. It is bowled outside off and Richa Ghosh swings hard across the line but is undone by the lack of pace completely.
On a length around middle, Gongadi Trisha heaves it away toward deep mid-wicket and picks up a run.
Short again and well outside off, Richa Ghosh has to really reach for it but manages to get it toward sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Slashed and slashed hard! This is short and wide, Richa Ghosh hammers it away wide of third man for a boundary.
A touch fuller and around off, Richa Ghosh goes deep in her crease and goes hard at it but mistimes it completely toward mid off.
Good length outside off, Gongadi Trisha goes after it but gets a thick outside edge down to third man for a single.
Orla Montgomery is brought back into the attack.
Dars this one full and on the pads, Gongadi Trisha works it towards deep backward square leg for one more.
DROPPED AGAIN! This is flighted, full and on midde, Richa Ghosh slog-sweeps it straight towards deep square leg where Orla Montgomery spills it out. Richa Ghosh gets another life. A single is taken.
Shortish and on middle, Gongadi Trisha nudges it towards square leg for a run.
A low full toss, on off,  Richa Ghosh goes down but mistimes her slog through mid-on for one.

Overthrows! This is floated, full and on off, Richa Ghosh goes down and mistimes her paddle sweep towards short fine leg and sets off for the run. The fielder throws at the bowler's end where the ball hits Richa and goes towards long on. The batters get another run.

DROPPED! This is a bit short and on leg, Richa Ghosh moves across and scoops it uppishly towards the short fine leg where the fielder leaps up, but fails to grab it. Two runs taken! Richa Ghosh gets a life.

FIVE WIDES! Darcey Carter fires this full and way down the leg side, Richa Ghosh looks to sweep it away, but misses and the keeper fails to stop it as well and the ball races to the fine leg fence for a boudnary.
There is a slight hold up in the play as the physio is out to have a look at Richa Ghosh. Everything seems to be fine and we are good to continue. Also, Darcey Carter comes into the attack now.
Flighted, full and on middle, Gongadi Trisha tucks it towards short mid-wicket. Scotland Women Under-19 are keeping the the batters quiet at the moment.
Looped up, full and on off, Richa Ghosh drives it towards long off for a single.
Slightly shorter and in middle, Gongadi Trisha slaps it towards long on for one more.
Floated, full and on middle, Richa Ghosh drills it towards long on for a run.
Short and outside off, Richa Ghosh moves back and punches it towards covers where the fielder dives to her left to stop it.
Tossed up, full and on off, Richa Ghosh turn it towards mid-wicket.
Shortish and on middle, Gongadi Trisha pushes it back to the bowler.
Tossed up, full and on off, Gongadi Trisha drives it straight to covers.
Slower through the air, on off, turning in, Gongadi Trisha nudges to the leg side.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Richa Ghosh chips it towards long on for a run.
Short and on off, Richa Ghosh looks to dab it away, but chops it onto the ground.
Floated, full and on middle, Gongadi Trisha turns it towards mid-wicket for a quick single.
Olivia Bell (2-0-9-0) is back on.

FIFTY FOR TRISHA! This has been an excellent knock from her and she ahs took full advantage of opening the innings. This is flighted, ful and on off, Gongadi Trisha drives it towards long off for a run.
Floated, full and on leg, Richa Ghosh paddles it towards short fine leg for one.
This is a bit short and on off, Richa Ghosh looks to push it away, but gets an inside edge onto her pads.
Full again and on middle, Gongadi Trisha flicks it through square leg for a run.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Richa Ghosh tucks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Lovely shot! This is short and outside off, Richa Ghosh frees her armas and cuts it through point for a boundary.
A slower one, full and on middle, Richa Ghosh works it towards long on for a run.
Back of a lenght and on off, shaping away, Richa Ghosh looks to cut it away, but misses.
Overpitched and on off, Gongadi Trisha eases it towards long off for a single.
FOUR! Gongadi Trisha finds the fence this time! This is on a good length and on off, Gongadi Trisha stays there and punches it through extra covers and finds the boudnary this time.
Full again and on offf, Gongadi Trisha drills it through extra covers as the long off fielder runs and collects it. Two runs taken!
Full and outside off, Gongadi Trisha drives it wide of long off and comes back for the second run.

Drinks! India Women Under-19 are finding it a bit difficult to score runs on the surface, but they know that they have the players who can accelerate at any point. So, they would not be that conerned at the moment. Scotland Women Under-19 have bowled really well and will look to continue the good work.
Flighted delivery on middle and leg, Gongadi Trisha pushes it in front of mid-wicket and collects a single. At the halfway mark, India Women Under-19 are 58/2!
Gives it a nice loop and floats it up full and outside off. Gongadi Trisha looks to cover drive but is well beaten.
Tossed up, full and around off, Richa Ghosh drives it through wide mid-off and rotates the strike.
Around middle, this is worked away leg side for a single.
FOUR! Top shot! Just a fraction short and wide, Gongadi Trisha rocks back and cuts it hard and past backward point for a boundary.
Starts off with a flatter delivery that is angled in from outside off. Gongadi Trisha pushes it out off the back foot.
Niamh Robertson-Jack comes into the attack now.
Well bowled! This is very full and outside off, right in the blockhole. Richa Ghosh looks to squeeze it away but the ball sneaks under the willow.
Fuller and angling down leg, Gongadi Trisha flicks it behind square on the leg side for one more.
This is angling into the pads, Richa Ghosh flicks it through square leg for a single. The 50 is now up for India Women Under-19.

DROPPED! Tough chance this but Nayma Shaikh will feel she should have held onto that one. This is pitched up around middle and leg, Richa Ghosh tentatively pushes at it uppishly to the right of the bowler. Shaikh dives and gets both hands on it but fumbles the ball.
FOUR! Nicely done! This is full and wide, Richa Ghosh opens the face of the bat a bit and squeezes it behind point for a boundary.
WIDE! This is fuller and down the leg side, well collected by Ailsa Lister behind the sticks. Wided.
Opportunity missed! This is a juicy full toss on middle, Gongadi Trisha only manages to pull it toward deep mid-wicket for a single.
Nayma Shaikh comes back into the attack.
This is banged into the pitch again and outside off, Trisha looks to cut but ends up dabbing it down to third man for a run.
This is short and wide, Gongadi Trisha reaches out and slaps it wide of the man at third man for a couple of runs.
Goes fuller now and angles it into middle and leg, Richa Ghosh clips it in front of mid-wicket and picks up a single.
And again! This is bowled back of a length and around off, Richa Ghosh looks to cut hard but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Beaten! On a good length around off, Richa Ghosh walks down the track and looks to play it on the off side but is well beaten.
WIDE! This is banged in short but angling down the leg side. Ghosh misses the pull and a wide is called.
This is bowled on a length around off and angling in, Richa Ghosh pushes it out on the off side.
Nicely flighted around middle, Richa Ghosh reaches forward and pushes it down to long on for one.
A huge amount of turn but it's slow turn. This is floated up around off and the ball turns into Ghosh's pads. Ghosh fails to work it away.
Tossed up around middle, this is nudged away onto the leg side for a run.
Slows it up now and pulls back the length as well, Gongadi Trisha goes on the back foot but fails to get the cut shot past backward point.
Flighted delivery around off, Trisha pushes it back to the bowler.
This is tossed up full and around off, Richa Ghosh knocks it down to long off for a single.
A dot to end and after the Powerplay, India Women Under-19 are 35/2! This is pitched up around off, Gongadi Trisha bunts it back to the bowler who makes a half-stop.
This is short over middle, Richa Ghosh rocks back and pulls it hard toward deep square leg for one.
Richa Ghosh comes out to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Smart bowling from Orla Montgomery and India Women Under-19 lose their second wicket inside the Powerplay. Soniya Mendhiya looks to walk down the track and seeing this, Orla bangs it in short and outside off. Soniya is hurried on as shes looks to pull but gets a top edge that loops up behind and Ailsa Lister behind the sticks takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Ailsa Lister b Orla Montgomery

Commentary.Commentary: Goes full and keeps it outside off, this is stroked away through extra cover for a single.
FOUR! Too short and way too wide as well. This is banged in well outside off, Gongadi Trisha gets on top of the bounce and slaps it past point for a boundary.
Starts off with a full ball outside off, Gongadi Trisha drives it square of the wicket through cover-point for a couple of runs.
Orla Montgomery to have a bowl now.

This has been a slow start from India Women Under-19 considering the first two games. Credit must go to Scotland Women Under-19, but they will need to build on this start to put more pressure on the Indians.
A bit short and on middle, turning in, Gongadi Trisha moves back and slaps it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Flighted delivery, full and on middle, Soniya Mendhiya eases it towards long on for a run.
Floated, full and on off, Soniya Mendhiya moves across and mistimes her sweep towards square leg.
A low full toss, on off, Gongadi Trisha drives it towards short extra cover where the fielder deflects it past mid off. They cross.
Tossed up, full and on off, Gongadi Trisha blocks it to the off side.
Katherine Fraser begins with a flighted delivery, full and on middle, Soniya Mendhiya tucks it through square leg for a single.
Katherine Fraser brings herself into the attack now.
Nayma Shaikh continues with her fuller length, on middle, Soniya Mendhiya flicks ti towards mid on once again for a run.
A single as this full delivery is drilled towards mid on by Trisha.
Another full delivery, on middle, Gongadi Trisha drives it past the diving mid on fielder for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Deft touch! Nayma Shaikh serves this a touch fuller and outside off, Gongadi Trisha waits for it and dabs it late towards the vacant third man fence for a boundary.
Pitched up, on middle, Soniya Mendhiya gets to the pitch of it and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
This is full and on off, Soniya Mendhiya drives it towards coevrs.
Another full delivery, on off, Gongadi Trisha drills it towards point.
Overpitched and on middle, Gongadi Trisha works it towards short mid-wicket.

Run out chance....missed! This is short and outside off, Gongadi Trisha chops it towards the third man region and sets off for the run. However, Gongadi Trisha calls for the second run a bit late and the fielder throws at the keeper's end, but the keeper fails to collect it and the chance goes begging as Trisha was well short of here crease.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Olivia Bell lands this short and on leg, Gongadi Trisha moves back and pulls it towards the deep square leg fence for a boundary.
On a length and on off, Gongadi Trisha dabs it towards point.
Fuller one and on middle, Soniya Mendhiya drives it towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Nice placement! Nayma Shaikh serves this full and around off, Gongadi Trisha stays there and steers it through backward point for a boundary.
On a length and on middle, Soniya Mendhiya flicks through square leg for a single and gets off the mark.
Full again and on middle, Soniya Mendhiya finds short mid-wicket again.
Full and on middle, Soniya Mendhiya works it towards short mid-wicket.
Soniya Mendhiya walks in at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Nayma Shaikh draws first blood! Scotland Women Under-19 players are jumping with joy as they know this is a huge, huge wicket for them. They have got the big fish, Shafali Verma early on. Nayma Shaikh lands this a bit short and on middle, Shafali Verma looks to heave it away, but fails to get the timing right and hits it in the air towards deep mid-wicket where Katherine Fraser settles under it and pouches it safely under pressure. India Women Under-19 lose their first wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Katherine Fraser b Nayma Shaikh

Commentary.Commentary: Nayma Shaikh starts with a good-length delivery, on off, Shafali Verma knocks it towards short covers.
Nayma Shaikh to operate from the other end.
Short again and outside off, Gongadi Trisha cuts it straight to point. A tidy start for Scotland Women Under-19!
Flighted, short and on off, turning in, Gongadi Trisha moves back and pushes it towards covers.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Shafali Verma clips it towards deep mid-wicket for a single and gets off the mark.
Flatter, full and on leg, Gongadi Trisha uses her feet and tucks it towards short fine leg where a misfield allows a run. India Women Under-19 are underway!
Looped up, full and on off, Gongadi Trisha leans on and blocks it out.
Olivia Bell starts with a floated delivery, short and on middle, Gongadi Trisha turns it to the leg side.

We are ready for play! The umpires are out in the middle and so are the players of Scotland Women Under-19. Gongadi Trisha is all set to open the innings alongside Shafali Verma for India Women Under-19. Olivia Bell will get proceedings underway with the ball here. Let's play...

Katherine Fraser, the captain of Scotland Women Under-19 says that they were going to bowl first anyway. Informs that Maisie Maciera goes out for Emily Tucker. Adds that they were a bit taken aback by the loss against South Africa as they had got themselves in a good position but will look to improve here.

India Women Under-19 skipper, Shafali Verma says that they will bat first. Adds that the wicket is looking good and they will want to post a good total. Mentions that they looking to give an opportunity to everyone, but the focus is still to win the game. Informs they have made a couple of changes.

Scotland Women Under-19 (Playing XI) - Ailsa Lister (WK), Darcey Carter, Emma Walsingham, Katherine Fraser (C), Emily Tucker (In for Maisie Maciera), Olivia Bell, Maryam Faisal, Nayma Shaikh, Niamh Muir, Orla Montgomery and Niamh Robertson-Jack.

India Women Under-19 (Playing XI) - Gongadi Trisha, Shafali Verma (C), Soniya Mendhiya, Hrishita Basu (WK), Richa Ghosh, Shweta Sehrawat, Titas Sadhu, Archana Devi, Mannat Kashyap, Yashasri (In for Parshavi Chopra) and Sonam Yadav (In for Shabnam MD).
TOSS - India Women Under-19 won the toss and they will BAT first.

Scotland Women Under-19, on the other hand, has not been able to show their quality at this stage. Their batting looks very bleak, with only Emma Walsingham scoring a few runs, while their bowlers have also struggled. This is a great learning process for them to gain experience and plan for the future. However, we have seen a few upsets in this World Cup, and writing off Scotland Women Under-19 wouldn't be a smart thing to do. They have nothing to lose and will come all guns blazing, which makes them even more dangerous. Will we see another upset here? Or will India Women Under-19 go on its merry way? We will find out soon. Toss and team news in a bit.

India Women Under-19 has looked like a side on a different level, and they are hungry for more. Their batting is probably the best in the competition, and having two classy international players like Shafali Verma and Richa Ghosh helps a lot too. However, their best player in the two games has been Shweta Sehrawat, who looks like a great future prospect. Their bowling needs to improve a bit to go all the way in this tournament.

Hello and a warm welcome, folks! It is almost time for the third and final group stage game for India Women Under-19 where they will be up against Scotland Women Under-19. India Women Under-19 will look to maintain their perfect record in the tournament, while this is a do-or-die situation for Scotland Women Under-19 if they want to stay alive and open their account.
... MATCH DAY ...

The inaugural ICC Under-19 Women’s T20 World Cup has already provided us with a bunch of surprises and loads of entertainment with some stellar performances by the young upcoming women cricketers of the world. We arrive at the third and final set of games in group D in the group stages with India Women Under-19 taking on Scotland Women Under-19 at Willowmoore Park B Field in Benoni for match number 20. The two teams find themselves in contrasting situations with India Women Under-19 destined for the top spot in the table having won both their previous games and Scotland Women Under-19 requiring a miraculous win to keep them in contention of qualifying for the Super Six having suffered two defeats so far. The ladies from the subcontinent are one of the favourites in this competition and have ascertained their reputation with two comprehensive wins backed by their strong batting line-up. Shafali Verma has got them off to explosive starts in both games but the star with the bat has been vice-captain Shweta Sehrawat who is yet to be dismissed in the competition and has two half-centuries under her belt. Richa Ghosh showed her hitting prowess in the last match and they have some talented players like Gongadi Trisha and Soniya Mendhiya in their middle order. The bowlers took a pounding in the first match but came back stronger in the previous fixture with Parshavi Chopra looking in fine touch. Shabnam MD, Titas Sadhu, and Mannat Kashyap also look in a good rhythm and are bound to grow in strength as the tournament progresses. Scotland Women Under-19 were the Europe Qualifiers winnners but look to be slightly out of their depth at this level as their batting has been completely out of sorts. Barring Emma Walsingham, none of the other batters have been able to get going and they will want to put their best foot forward in what could be their last fixture. Their bowling has been much more disciplined with Olivia Bell, Nayma Shaikh, Katherine Fraser, Niamh Robertson-Jack, and Maisie Maciera all with wickets under their belt. India Women Under-19 are clear favourites going into this game but do we have an upset on the cards? We will find out soon.
